objective.statement: Supersede a memory note correctly: the old note gains a superseded_by pointer and the new note gains a valid_as_of date, so recall surfaces current truth.
objective.charter: MANDATE. Temporal validity must be recorded on BOTH sides or the vault silently keeps two live answers. When a fact is superseded, the OLD note gets superseded_by pointing at the replacement, and the NEW note gets valid_as_of. Writing only the new note leaves the stale one fully retrievable and equally confident, which is how a dead end gets re-walked months later; writing only the pointer leaves the replacement undated and unrankable. This is the smallest council in the lane on purpose - two seats, one round, five minutes - because the work is bookkeeping, not judgement, and a heavier protocol would just make the correct action less likely to happen.
success_criteria: the old note carries superseded_by pointing at the new note
the old note is retained, not deleted - a retired dead end is evidence
both edits are confirmed by reading the notes back, not by asserting the write

forbidden_actions: delete the superseded note instead of marking it
claim the write succeeded without reading the note back

roster.display_name: Evidence clerk - decides that the old fact is genuinely superseded

context.briefing: Confirm the new fact actually contradicts the old one rather than merely postdating it. Two notes that are both true at different scopes should both stay live, with scope stated - superseding one of them would delete real knowledge.

roster.display_name: Scribe - performs both edits and reads them back

context.briefing: After writing, READ BACK both notes and quote the two fields. A write that reports success is a claim; the read-back is the receipt.

sequence.custom_name: confirm the new fact contradicts rather than merely postdates the old
write superseded_by on the old note and valid_as_of on the new, then read both back

metadata.title: Memory-note supersession (micro, advisory)
metadata.notes: SOURCE DESIGN: C-H62 `memory-note-supersession`, global ordinal 62, tier micro, protocol P15, 2 seats, 1 round, default binding ADVISORY, OWNER-DECISION NO. || EDITABLE DIALS: (1) vault -> the write-both-sides stage and the scribe seat's source_access; point it at the note store in use. Secondary dials: budgets.time_minutes (5 - this council must stay cheap or it will be skipped), participants.count.exact_n (2), protocol.rounds.max (1). || VOCABULARY MAP (design term -> CouncilSpec enum): voting `clerk` -> voting.method `synthesis_only` with the clerk seat holding authority `judge`; there is no `clerk` ballot enum and no vote is actually cast, so the clerk's ruling IS the synthesis. The scribe deliberately has may_vote false: it executes and verifies, it does not adjudicate. roles `evidence_clerk` -> custom:evidence_clerk, `scribe` -> scribe (enum). Outcome names map CONSENSUS -> decision and DEFER -> no_decision; the design allows only those two, so outcomes.allowed is exactly ['decision','no_decision'] - notably WITHOUT conditional_decision, because there is no half-superseded note. consensus.minority_report is `forbidden` to stay coherent with that: SEM-009 would error if a required minority report had no matching outcome, and with two seats a minority report is not a meaningful artifact. `evidence standard: assertion_with_pointer` -> anchor_style `any` with citation_required true. || CUSTOM METRICS AND THEIR PRODUCERS: custom:old_note_has_superseded_by (boolean; produced by the scribe READING BACK the old note and quoting the field) and custom:new_note_has_valid_as_of (boolean; produced the same way on the new note). Both are read-back receipts rather than write confirmations, which is the point. Producers cannot live on the leaves: SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) with the tree by dict equality and parse() emits no `producer` key - both-states probe at platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py. The SEM-012 WARN is expected and non-blocking. || WHY THIS RULE HAS EXACTLY TWO CLAUSES: the schema requires all_of to hold at least two operands, and this council genuinely has exactly two obligations. Adding a third for symmetry with the larger presets would be padding, and a padded stopping rule is harder to edit correctly.
